chapter.title: Chapter Fifteen: Premiere Night
chapter.subtitle: Packed house. Missing signature. Nine fifty-three.
chapter.description: On the option deadline, the block runs its largest event while a missing signature threatens the cooperative plan.

tips: Listen for the terms before the first contest.

scenes.speaker: Snitch
scenes.text: Premiere night: traveling museum, open tournament, childcare room, and no functioning ticket printer.

scenes.speaker: Cornball
scenes.text: I am handwriting tickets. My wrist now has a union representative.

scenes.speaker: Baby Momma
scenes.text: Childcare check-in is not content. Cameras stay outside the blue tape.

scenes.speaker: Snitch
scenes.text: My lens has never respected tape this quickly.

scenes.speaker: Cracked Head
scenes.text: Snack station stocked. Pickup schedule covered. I am not entering the first table.

scenes.speaker: Ganger Blue
scenes.text: You sure?

scenes.speaker: Cracked Head
scenes.text: My kid’s waiting at the snack table. I’m not making them watch me choose a crowd again.

scenes.speaker: Wifey
scenes.text: Somebody frame that after he finishes cutting apples.

scenes.speaker: Ganger Red
scenes.text: We are missing the partner-venue signature that proves overflow access.

scenes.speaker: Alley Runner
scenes.text: Courier has it, but Rich's launch barricade blocked the direct route.

tips: Its result settles only the stated event term.

starObjectives.description: Move at least one of your cards.

preDialogue.speaker: Hooper
preDialogue.text: Winner runs overflow seating. Loser runs the same seating under their direction.

preDialogue.speaker: Bottle Girl
preDialogue.text: Good. Somebody finally made losing useful.

preDialogue.speaker: Cornball
preDialogue.text: Center lane closes because I put three hundred handwritten tickets there to dry.

preDialogue.speaker: Hooper
preDialogue.text: Nobody sneeze until round five.

preDialogue.speaker: Bottle Girl
preDialogue.text: Overflow line around the block. Same door rules. No VIP rope.

preDialogue.speaker: Promoter
preDialogue.text: I can open a second entrance if the fire code allow.

preDialogue.speaker: Wifey
preDialogue.text: Fire code allow one controlled entrance. We already checked.

preDialogue.speaker: Cornball
preDialogue.text: I’m counting heads and receipts. Overflow don’t mean chaos.

preDialogue.speaker: Ganger Blue
preDialogue.text: I’ll work the line. No throne. Just the line.

postDialogue.speaker: Hooper
postDialogue.text: Overflow is yours. I will keep the stairs clear.

postDialogue.speaker: Cornball
postDialogue.text: One ticket attached itself to Rich's shoe and gained backstage access.

postDialogue.speaker: Bottle Girl
postDialogue.text: Line moving. Nobody cut. Fire code smiling.

postDialogue.speaker: Ganger Blue
postDialogue.text: Line work is honest work. I’m good.

postDialogue.speaker: Cornball
postDialogue.text: Both logged. Overflow handled. Archive proud.

starObjectives.description: Move at least one of your cards.

tips: Order the evidence by its authentic timestamps.

puzzle.title: Nine fifty-three, seal intact
puzzle.instruction: Rebuild the packet’s five handoffs. Match each recorded OUT custody code to the next IN code. Start at the partner’s signature and finish with the owner. A crowd photo alone does not prove a handoff.

pieces.label: Owner receives — 21:53
pieces.detail: IN B7. Seal 41 intact; owner signs receipt.

pieces.label: Courier receives
pieces.detail: IN P4 → OUT C9. Seal 41 intact.

pieces.label: Blue receives
pieces.detail: IN W2 → OUT B7. Seal 41 intact; microphone already handed over.

pieces.label: Partner signs — 20:42
pieces.detail: No incoming code. Packet sealed 41; OUT P4.

pieces.label: Stage desk receives
pieces.detail: IN C9 → OUT W2. Seal 41 intact; logged at the side table.

hints: The signed partner copy is the only record with no incoming code.
Follow P4, then C9, then W2, then B7.
puzzle.solvedText: Seal 41 stays intact through every matched handoff. The owner receives the completed packet at 21:53, seven minutes before Rich’s reservation ends.
puzzle.skipText: The group orders the copies together. You receive the same story progress, with no puzzle bonus.

scenes.speaker: Ganger Red
scenes.text: Five custody marks. We need one unbroken path to the owner.

scenes.speaker: Alley Runner
scenes.text: My copy has the seal number at each handoff. Match those, not whoever looks official in the photo.

scenes.speaker: Cornball
scenes.text: I am wearing an EVENT NOTARY hat.

scenes.speaker: Wifey
scenes.text: And holding the envelope upside down. Start over.

tips: Its result settles only the stated event term.

preDialogue.speaker: Alley Runner
preDialogue.text: Contest picks who carries the agreement through the crowd. The route stays public either way.

preDialogue.speaker: Ganger Red
preDialogue.text: No hero shortcuts. Chain of custody at every handoff.

preDialogue.speaker: Snitch
preDialogue.text: I can film the route from behind the privacy line.

preDialogue.speaker: Baby Momma
preDialogue.text: You can film the document. Leave families out of your background.

preDialogue.speaker: Alley Runner
preDialogue.text: Partner venues sent couriers with signed hour sheets. Three doors still open across town.

preDialogue.speaker: Delivery Demon
preDialogue.text: I got the sheets and the seals. No conflicting addresses this time.

preDialogue.speaker: Ganger Red
preDialogue.text: Good. Those doors are the backup if this roof ever need to breathe.

preDialogue.speaker: Cornball
preDialogue.text: Backup doors logged. Network stronger than any single logo.

preDialogue.speaker: Baby Momma
preDialogue.text: Network that don’t film the kids. Keep that part.

postDialogue.speaker: Alley Runner
postDialogue.text: You carry. I call each handoff and keep the copy.

postDialogue.speaker: Ganger Red
postDialogue.text: Seal number matches. Only the owner’s countersignature remains.

postDialogue.speaker: Cornball
postDialogue.text: I offered the envelope a wristband. It declined colors.

postDialogue.speaker: Alley Runner
postDialogue.text: Sheets filed. Seals match. Partner hours locked for the season.

postDialogue.speaker: Delivery Demon
postDialogue.text: No inflatable letters this run. Progress.

postDialogue.speaker: Cornball
postDialogue.text: Progress without inflatables. I’m framing the quiet.

tips: Its result settles only the stated event term.

phases.name: Public Pressure
phases.description: At round three, the opponent gains 1 Motion.

phases.name: Late Arrival
phases.description: At round 6, the opponent draws one card from its remaining ten-card deck. If the deck is empty, no card is added.

passive.name: Announced Terms
passive.description: The final table escalates once without changing the agreement outside the match.

preDialogue.speaker: Techbro Rich
preDialogue.text: My launch starts at ten. Winner gets the stage until nine-fifty-five.

preDialogue.speaker: Ganger Blue
preDialogue.text: Stage time only. No claim over the roof, signature, or crowd.

preDialogue.speaker: Techbro Rich
preDialogue.text: You people have become exhausting about nouns.

preDialogue.speaker: Wifey
preDialogue.text: Four years of consequences will do that. Shuffle.

preDialogue.speaker: Snitch
preDialogue.text: Full feed, source credits first, comments locked for public safety.

preDialogue.speaker: Ganger Red
preDialogue.text: Credits before the channel name. Non-negotiable.

preDialogue.speaker: Techbro Rich
preDialogue.text: I’ll take the back row. No pitch. Just the show.

preDialogue.speaker: Wifey
preDialogue.text: Back row is fine. Front row is for the people who cleaned.

preDialogue.speaker: Cornball
preDialogue.text: I made popcorn in the old fog machine. Tastes like batteries and closure.

postDialogue.speaker: Techbro Rich
postDialogue.text: Stage is yours until nine-fifty-five. My countdown continues.

postDialogue.speaker: Ganger Blue
postDialogue.text: Then use our five minutes to read the access agreement, not celebrate me.

postDialogue.speaker: Wifey
postDialogue.text: There he is. Annoying in a promising new direction.

postDialogue.speaker: Snitch
postDialogue.text: Feed clean. Credits first. No crop. I’m almost a journalist.

postDialogue.speaker: Ganger Red
postDialogue.text: Almost counts. Keep the source list public.

postDialogue.speaker: Cornball
postDialogue.text: Journalist status pending. Popcorn status legendary.

tips: The match result and the real-world agreement remain separate.

scenes.speaker: Ganger Red
scenes.text: Packet is complete. The owner is reviewing it before Rich's option expires.

scenes.speaker: Techbro Rich
scenes.text: Reviewing it doesn’t mean she signed. I checked twice.

scenes.speaker: Baby Momma
scenes.text: Correct. Look at us all using precise nouns.

scenes.speaker: Cracked Head
scenes.text: Snack shift complete. My kid rated the apples 'too apple.' I accept the note.

scenes.speaker: OG Uncle
scenes.text: The crowd stayed, the exits stayed clear, and nobody needed a miracle.

scenes.speaker: Snitch
scenes.text: Nine fifty-nine. Rich's inflatable logo just lost air.

scenes.speaker: Cornball
scenes.text: The R has returned to civilian life.

scenes.speaker: Wifey
scenes.text: Whatever the owner decides, this operation exists in more than speeches now.

scenes.speaker: Alley Runner
scenes.text: And if the roof closes, three partner spaces signed continuity hours.
